data.name: Latifat
data.gender_notes: Latifat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is gentle, soft, and tender in nature. The name Latifat carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Latifat usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the gentle and compassionate side of Allah (swt)
data.etymology: Latifat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Latifat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: لطيفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لطيفة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي لطف، ويعني اللطيف والكريم والرقيق. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية ١٢٣ 'وَلَا يَأۡخُذُكُم بِاللَّطِيفِ إِلَّا مَن أَطاعَ اللَّهَ عَزِيزًا ذَكِيًّا'، يدل على صفة من صفات الله تعالى. يستخدم الاسم للإناث، ويعبر عن معاني الجمال والرقة.

in_urdu.name: لطیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: لطیفہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، نازک، اور شریف
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام لطیفہ عربی زبان کی لطيف کے معنی میں ہے، جو خوبصورت، نازک، اور شریف کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے. یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں عام ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا اہمیت ہے. لطیفہ نام رکھنے والوں میں رقت، شفقت، اور خوبصورتی جیسی صفات پائی جاتی ہیں.

in_hindi.name: लतीफा
in_hindi.meaning: लतीफा का अर्थ है सुंदर, कोमल, और शरीफ
in_hindi.long_meaning: लतीफा नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर, कोमल, और शरीफ. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है और इसे सुंदरता, दयालुता, और सादगी के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है. लतीफा नाम रखने वाले व्यक्तियों में सहानुभूति, नम्रता, और सौंदर्य जैसी विशेषताएं पाई जाती हैं.

in_pashto.name: لطيفه
in_pashto.meaning: لطيفه د ښکلا، نرموالي، او شرافت مانا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د لطيفه نوم په عربي ژبه کې د لطيف څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د ښکلا، نرموالي، او شرافت لپاره کارول کیږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو تر منځ عام دی او د ښکلا، شفقت، او سادگي د نښه په توګه لیدل کیږي. لطيفه نوم لرونکو کسانو کې مهربانۍ، نرموالي، او ښکلا لکه ځانګړتیاوې موندل کیږي.

in_english.name: Latifat
in_english.meaning: Beautiful, delicate, kind and refined qualities
in_english.long_meaning: The name Latifat originates from the Arabic root 'l-ṭ-f', meaning beautiful, delicate, kind, and refined. It appears in the Quran, emphasizing divine attributes. Historically, Latifat symbolizes elegance, compassion, and inner beauty in Islamic tradition. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as empathy, gentleness, and charm across various Muslim cultures.

It values tenderness, empathy, and peaceful attitudes, which are traits that are often emphasized in Islamic teachings and daily living. This name may be given to a child who is shown to exhibit these qualities, encouraging them to continue nurturing and exhibiting these attributes as they grow.

Islam emphasizes the importance of recognizing and appreciating these subtleties in both our inner and outer worlds. In Sufism, the belief is that by focusing on these subtle virtues and peculiarities, one can deepen their connection to the Divine. Thus, a person with the name Latifat is reminded to uphold a gentle, refined, and compassionate demeanor, reflecting the Divine attributes of Mercy, Love, and Compassion.
